chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
"The minimum of menstruation is three, and its maximum is ten."

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum limit or least amount
key_terms.أَقْصَاهُ: its maximum limit or furthest extent
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation; the state and period of menstrual bleeding in legal context
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: three; the minimum number of days stated here
key_terms.عَشَرَةٌ: ten; the maximum number of days stated here

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of hayd (menstruation) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the minimum and maximum duration of hayd (menstruation). It establishes the juristic limits used in determining related rulings of ritual purity and worship.
